• U-7 must be explicitly excluded from the licensed scope, with university consent required for any deployment containing it
• Sublicensing must be limited to Orion Industrial as named distributor, not open-ended
• Our company retains ownership of all background technology and improvements — Meridian gets rights to improvements developed during the term, but ownership stays with us

Do I have that right? And are there any other issues anyone sees before I direct the drafting changes?
